changes: Renamed Improved Configs (id unchanged). New SEQUENCER CONFIG row PAD LEAVES FX (storage field pad_leaves_fx_on): with the FX track selected, a pad or TRIG 1-12 press that selects its track leaves the FX track for that track's page, as TRK + pad does. Two jsr sites over the pad and TRIG handlers' stay-on-FX flag (0x400c7b5c, 0x400c7eb4); unchecked, the flag is stock's.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
